units: Lev. R. s. 28, a. e. (ref. to שאף, Job V, 5), v. דָּחַק. Tanḥ. Mick. 2 (ref. to Dan. II, 2) אשפים לשון דחק שנ׳ השואפים וכ׳ the root in ashshafim signifies pressure, as we read (Am. VIII, 4), ‘hear ye this, hashshoăfim (who press) the needy.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 51">Midr. Till. to Ps. LI</cite>. <he>כל מי … ושׁוֹאֵף ברגלו וכ׳</he> he who knows that he has sinned, but stamps with his foot and removes the sin from his sight &c.; a. e.
